prompt: RFC 1035 resolver SLIST address no history round trip time
answer: For an SLIST address with no history, RFC 1035 says to assume an expected round-trip time of **5–10 seconds in the worst case**, using lower estimates when the server is on the same local network. The history is maintained **per address**, not merely per name server.
